Call unchanged inventory_names and task grouped_contracts; save one group-contracts list. Invoke one exact parent through unchanged run(contract), use unchanged grouped_result, append at most one original parent record. Observe both originals around inventory and selected use; all writes/errors follow the declared sticky policy.
